description: Na₃CaInP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.90 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.83 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.34 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted InO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-43°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-43°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.60 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-37°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na, one In, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one In, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one In, and one P atom.
